naslov: Anthropic: experts adopt an agent's random opinions and think they're their own
opis:
Anthropic gave 50 experts a causal-analysis agent whose stance was decided by a coin flip, across five analytical decisions where both options were valid. In 86% of cases, the experts chose what the agent advocated, and seniority, education and trust in AI didn't protect them.

Why it matters: If you're building a tool where AI makes recommendations, this study offers clear advice: have the agent present the strongest arguments for both sides, or ask the user…

naslov: Try AnyDecisionModel and AnySpeechRecognizer (Swift): Two Swift packages from Hugging Face
opis:
Two Swift packages from Hugging Face.

How to try it:
1. You need Swift 6.2+ and iOS 26 / macOS 26; the MLX backend and Parakeet need Apple silicon
2. Add both packages to Package.swift (AnySpeechRecognizer 0.1.0, AnyDecisionModel 0.6.0) and enable the MLX, CoreAI or Llama trait
3. For speech, just replace import Speech with import AnySpeechRecognizer; for decisions, create a DecisionSession and start asking questions
4. Don't combine the CoreAI trait with AnySpeechRecognizer, as the dependencies are incompatible; speech has only been tested on macOS 27

Price: free (model licenses vary: CC BY 4.0, Apache 2.0, NVIDIA license)

Official link: https://huggingface.co/blog/anydecisionmodel
